entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return these absolutely worthless cycling shoes I bought. This is unacceptable.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with them. Do you have your order number handy?
It's VF8675309. Look, I don't have time for a runaround. I wore them twice and they're already giving me blisters. I want a full refund, and I want it now.
I understand your frustration. Let me pull up that order. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Road Cycling Shoes. It looks like they were delivered 17 days ago.

I don't care if it was 17 days or 17 minutes! Are you trying to tell me I can't return them? The cleats feel misaligned and the fit is terrible. I want to talk to your manager. This is ridiculous. I'll post a review on every single website if you don't give me my money back.

Sir, there's no need for that. I was just confirming the order details. You are absolutely correct, and I apologize if I wasn't clear. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days on these shoes, so you are well within the timeframe.
Oh. Well... it should be. So you're going to process the refund?

Yes, of course. I can authorize the return for a full refund for you right now. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any shipping center.
Fine. Make sure that email comes through immediately. I don't want any more problems.

The email has just been sent. You should see it within the next few minutes. Once we receive the cycling shoes back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No. Just make sure it gets done. Goodbye.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
